Name: Eemie's Grass Variety for Content Patcher
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A conversion of Eemie's wildflower grass to Content Patcher
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's wildflower grass to Content Patcher, with bonus included Eemie's Just A New Recolor grass.  Configurable, with three total versions.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Eemie's Grass Variety' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
Config Options

*   Choose between Recolor, LightFlowers, and HeavyFlowers.  Defaults to LightFlowers.
Update log

*   1.0.0 - Initial version

Tip of the hat to [Seyph](https://community.playstarbound.com/members/seyph.628087/) on the forums for their work making an [unofficial conversion](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-6#post-3273640), though I did not use any of their coding work for this conversion.

Recolor seen in previews is [A Wittily Named Recolor](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995) by Ace.
